metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.4 · 2021 · Justice Society: World War II
metas.description: The Justice Society of America, a group of heroes aiding the allies in World War 2, acquire an ally from the future who sends them on an adventure that changes history.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 6.1 · 2022 · Green Lantern: Beware My Power
metas.description: Recently discharged Marine sniper John Stewart is at a crossroads in his life, one which is only complicated by receiving an extraterrestrial ring which grants him the powers of the Green Lantern of Earth.

metas.name: 7 · ★ 5.3 · 2023 · Justice League: Warworld
metas.description: Warworld, a place of unending brutal gladiatorial combat, Batman, Superman, Wonder Woman and others must unite to form an unbeatable resistance to lead the entire planet to freedom.

metas.name: 8 · ★ 6.2 · 2024 · Justice League: Crisis on Infinite Earths - Part One
metas.description: The Anti-Monitor, the Monitor's evil counterpart, is released into the DC Multiverse and begins to destroy the different Earths that compose it. The Monitor attempts to recruit heroes from across the Multiverse to fight back.

metas.description: The Anti-Monitor (the Monitor's evil counterpart) is released into the DC Multiverse and begins to destroy the different Earths that compose it. The Monitor attempts to recruit heroes from across the Multiverse to fight back.

metas.name: 10 · ★ 6.1 · 2024 · Justice League: Crisis on Infinite Earths - Part Three
metas.description: Trapped in a pocket universe, surviving Earths face annihilation by the Anti-Monitor. Time shatters, bringing past heroes to aid Justice League against the epitome of evil. Their sacrifice may lead to victory.
